itemText: Add a Knowledge list that browses every item, with filters by course and status.
Open an item to edit its question, answer and question variants.
Suspend or unsuspend an item, and list suspended items.
Delete or move several selected items at once.
Ask for a reason when rejecting a pending item and send it as feedback.
